dialogues.speaker: Karpa
dialogues.text: Hello. This is the contestants' lounge, so please be quiet.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Could I stick around for a bit?

dialogues.speaker: Karpa
dialogues.text: Ah, we've got no competitions on now, so feel free to hang around if you wish.

dialogues.speaker: Karpa
dialogues.text: Once the preparations for the Pilgrimage begin, though, staff and contestants will be given priority use of this area.

dialogues.speaker: Karpa
dialogues.text: I'll also be here to make some competition-related announcements, such as times, things to look out for, and so on.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Got it.

dialogues.speaker: Karpa
dialogues.text: Thanks for your cooperation.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me about the Pilgrimage...

dialogues.speaker: Karpa
dialogues.text: The Pilgrimage of the Return of the Sacred Flame is where contestants may win ultimate glory. All the people of Natlan are welcome to take part.

dialogues.speaker: Karpa
dialogues.text: The Pilgrimage of the Return of the Sacred Flame is held as needed in response to the Abyssal threat. As the incursions have grown worse in recent years, it's been held more frequently.

dialogues.speaker: Karpa
dialogues.text: In the name of victory, may you all keep fighting until the very end.

dialogues.speaker: Karpa
dialogues.text: But remember, you must never foment conflict for its own sake. All malicious acts will be laid bare under the Pyro Archon's vigilant gaze.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the Pilgrimage...

dialogues.speaker: Karpa
dialogues.text: The Pilgrimage of the Return of the Sacred Flame is where contestants may win ultimate glory. All the people of Natlan are welcome to take part.

dialogues.speaker: Karpa
dialogues.text: The Pilgrimage of the Return of the Sacred Flame is held as needed in response to the Abyssal threat. As the incursions have grown worse in recent years, it's been held more frequently.

dialogues.speaker: Karpa
dialogues.text: But considering the heavy losses that the Abyss suffered during the conflict, I think it's safe to say that the Pilgrimage can be postponed for a while.

dialogues.speaker: Karpa
dialogues.text: The Abyss hasn't gone for good though, so it's best to stay prepared. In the name of victory, may you all keep fighting until the very end.

dialogues.speaker: Karpa
dialogues.text: Just remember, you must never foment conflict for its own sake. All malicious acts will be laid bare under the Pyro Archon's vigilant gaze.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the Pilgrimage...

dialogues.speaker: Karpa
dialogues.text: The Pilgrimage of the Return of the Sacred Flame is where contestants may win ultimate glory. All the people of Natlan are welcome to take part.

dialogues.speaker: Karpa
dialogues.text: Before, the Pilgrimage of the Return of the Sacred Flame would be held as needed in response to the Abyssal threat, but now, it's held purely as a contest.

dialogues.speaker: Karpa
dialogues.text: In the name of victory, may you all keep fighting until the very end.

dialogues.speaker: Karpa
dialogues.text: Just remember, you must never foment conflict for its own sake. All malicious acts will be laid bare under the Pyro Archon's vigilant gaze.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I shall keep that in mind.

dialogues.speaker: Karpa
dialogues.text: Indeed. Natlan may be the nation of war, but conflict is not the goal of everything. May it guide you to true glory.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I shall keep that in mind.

dialogues.speaker: Karpa
dialogues.text: Indeed. Natlan has always been known as the nation of war, but conflict is not some be-all end-all goal. May it guide you to true glory.
